profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Salesforce
profile.geoLocationName: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
profile.summary:
I am a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (SMTS) with deep experience architecting, developing, and delivering secure, scalable, and high-performance applications across multiple industries — including Banking, E-commerce, Hospitality, SaaS, Order Management, Inventory Control, and Clinical Web Portals.

My background spans a wide range of technologies and platforms, with strong expertise in both Front End and Back End engineering:

💻 Technologies & Languages

.NET / C#, Java, Node.js, Apex

SQL, T-SQL, Oracle SQL, PostgreSQL, NoSQL

JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS

React, Lightning Web Components (LWC)

REST APIs, microservices, data integration pipelines

🏗 Platform, Architecture & Tools

Salesforce Core, Lightning Order Management (LOM)

Jest, Unit Tests, FTests, automation frameworks

Grafana dashboards, alerts, observability

CI/CD, DevOps practices, Git, cloud native workflows

Agile / Scrum, serving as both contributor and Scrum Master

At Salesforce, I serve as a Senior Member of Technical Staff, leading major engineering initiatives for the Lightning Order Management platform. My contributions include:

Redesigning the entire Order Management architecture

Building Fulfillment, Shipping, Allocation, Payments, Invoice, and Credit Memo systems

Developing Delivery Estimation UI and user workflows

Creating licenses, permissions, entitlements for Order Management products

Implementing cross-platform Job Systems for high-volume client data integration

Delivering GDPR-compliant modules for EU requirements

Creating Grafana dashboards, automated Slack alerts, and monitoring pipelines

Enhancing system reliability, scalability, and test coverage

I also promote secure development as a Cybersecurity Champion, ensuring best practices in privacy, threat modeling, and compliance.

To maximize productivity and quality, I actively use AI-assisted engineering tools (Windsurf, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and others) to improve design, testing, automation, and code optimization.

I’m passionate about building systems that are clean, reliable, scalable, and user-centered, while mentoring teams and driving engineering excellence across the stack.

positions.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS)
positions.description:
Order Management System (OMS) Development
Designed and developed major components of the Lightning Order Management System, including Fulfillment, Shipping, Allocation, Payments, Invoicing, and Credit Memo workflows.
Led the full redesign of the Salesforce OMS architecture, improving scalability, maintainability, and extensibility.
Built OMS v1 applications, laying the foundation for future enhancements.
Created Licenses and Permissions frameworks to govern access to OMS features across orgs.

Systems Integration & Data Processing
Built a robust Job System to synchronize and integrate high-volume data between client systems and Salesforce Platform.
Implemented secure workflows in compliance with General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) requirements for EU markets.

Frontend Engineering & User Experience
Developed intuitive Lightning Web Components (LWC) for critical OMS modules.
Designed the Delivery Estimation UI, improving transparency for fulfillment pipelines.
Wrote Jest tests to maintain strong UI test coverage.

Testing & Quality Engineering
Authored comprehensive Apex Unit Tests and FTests to ensure reliability and maintain >90% code coverage across OMS modules.
Championed testing best practices and quality automation.

Monitoring, Observability & Operations
Built Grafana dashboards to monitor OMS performance and service health.
Developed Slack-integrated alerting pipelines to notify engineering teams of outages, SLA violations, or system anomalies.
Provided ongoing production support and customer-facing troubleshooting.

AI-Enhanced Engineering Workflow
Utilize AI coding tools (Windsurf, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) in daily development to increase productivity, improve quality, and accelerate delivery timelines.

Collaboration & Leadership
Worked closely with TPMs, PMs, architects, designers, support teams, and cross-cloud engineering groups.
Regularly engaged with customers to diagnose issues, deliver solutions, and optimize OMS workflows.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed and enhanced Health Care Web applications to support for Lab Results using ASP.Net, VB.Net, C#, JavaScript, AJAX, JQuery, Oracle 10/11g.
•	Designed and developed CROWNWeb web application to streamline clinical data submissions process.
•	Designed dynamic Reporting tool to support multiple clinic’s custom reports.
•	Developed and enhanced Audit Trail system to audit all Health Care Web applications activities to meet HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) requirements.
•	Architected and developed Billing module to manage Patient Insurance/Medicare.
•	Developed Critical Notify tool to help Client Service monitor critical results and send results to clinics instantly using ASP.Net, VB.Net, Oracle 11g.
•	Designed and created a set of complicate Patient Reports using Actuate eReport.
•	Designed and created dynamic Patient Visit Forms to meet multiple clinics’ needs.
•	Architected and created Report Merging tool to merge reports with different formats to single pdf file.
•	Converted web applications from .Net 1.0 to .Net 4.0.
